en.name: Chinkiang vinegar
en.summary: Chinkiang vinegar is a genuine aged vinegar brewed from glutinous rice and wheat bran, dark, malty and mildly sweet. Unopened it keeps about 2 years in a cupboard. Once opened, about 12 months, and in both cases the limit is flavour rather than safety.
en.pantry: A cool, dark cupboard, capped tightly, away from the hob: about 2 years unopened from purchase and about 12 months once opened. Age is a selling point with this vinegar, so a bottle kept past its date is a quality question, not a safety one — but the malty top notes are the first thing to go, and light and air take them faster than time does. Sediment in the bottom of an aged bottle is normal. Never decant vinegar into a bare metal container.
en.fridge: Chinkiang vinegar does not need refrigeration and the published figures for it are cupboard figures. If your kitchen runs hot or a bottle is going to sit for a long stretch, the fridge does no harm and slows the aroma loss, but it changes nothing about safety. Wherever it lives, cap it tightly and wipe the neck after pouring.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for Chinkiang vinegar and no reason to freeze it. It is an acidic liquid that preserves itself on the shelf, and freezing would only cloud it and unsettle the sediment. Keep the freezer for things that genuinely need it.
spoilage: Mould around the neck or cap, usually in sticky residue
A flat, dusty taste with none of the malty aroma — old rather than unsafe
Solid matter floating in the bottle beyond the fine sediment you would expect
A metallic taste after being stored in a bare metal container
tips: Cap it tightly and keep it out of the light; air and sun cost more aroma than shelf time does.
Wipe the neck after pouring so the cap does not stick.
Recipes that rely on vinegar for safety assume 5 percent acidity — check the label before using this vinegar to preserve anything.
Keep it distinct from Taiwanese black vinegar, which is a seasoned blend rather than a straight brewed vinegar.

faq.q: How long does Chinkiang vinegar last after opening?
faq.a: About 12 months capped in a cool dark cupboard. Unopened, about 2 years.

faq.q: Does Chinkiang vinegar need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No. A cupboard is the standard. The fridge does no harm but is not needed for safety.

faq.q: Can you use Chinkiang vinegar for pickling?
faq.a: Only if the label confirms the acidity a tested recipe requires — pickling recipes assume 5 percent acidity for safety.

faq.q: Is the sediment at the bottom a problem?
faq.a: No. Aged vinegars drop fine sediment. Pour carefully or strain it if it bothers you.

zh.name: 鎮江香醋
zh.summary: 鎮江香醋是以糯米和麥麩釀造、經過陳放的真正釀造醋，色深、帶麥香、微甜。未開封放櫥櫃大約 2 年；開封後大約 12 個月。兩者的限制都是風味，不是安全。
zh.pantry: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃、蓋緊、遠離爐火：未開封從購買日起算大約 2 年，開封後大約 12 個月。陳年本來就是這種醋的賣點，所以放過期是品質問題而不是安全問題——但最先流失的是那股麥香前味，而光和空氣奪走它的速度比時間更快。陳年醋瓶底有沉澱是正常的。醋絕對不要倒進裸露的金屬容器。
zh.fridge: 鎮江香醋不需要冷藏，它公布的數字講的都是櫥櫃保存。如果廚房很熱，或一瓶會擱很久，放冰箱不會有壞處，也能減緩香氣流失，但對安全沒有任何影響。無論放哪裡，都請蓋緊，倒完擦一下瓶口。
zh.freezer: 鎮江香醋沒有冷凍期限，也沒有冷凍的理由。它是能自我保存的酸性液體，冷凍只會讓它變濁、把沉澱攪起來。冷凍庫留給真正需要的東西。
spoilage: 瓶口或瓶蓋周圍在黏垢處長霉
喝起來扁平無味、完全沒有麥香——那是老了，不是不安全
瓶中出現細沉澱以外的固體漂浮物
曾放在裸露金屬容器中，現在帶金屬味
tips: 蓋緊、避光；空氣和陽光造成的香氣損失大於架上的時間。
倒完擦瓶口，免得瓶蓋黏死。
靠醋來確保安全的配方預設 5% 酸度——要用它醃漬保存前請先看標示。
不要和台式烏醋混為一談，烏醋是調味混合醋，不是純釀造醋。

faq.q: 鎮江醋開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋緊放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 12 個月。未開封大約 2 年。
不用。櫥櫃就是標準做法。冰了無害，但安全上沒有必要。

faq.q: 鎮江醋可以拿來醃漬保存嗎？
faq.a: 要看標示的酸度是否符合經驗證配方的要求——醃漬配方為了安全預設 5% 酸度。
沒有。陳年醋本來就會析出細沉澱。小心倒或先過濾即可。
